name: The Missing Diplomat
summary: This tense confrontation is a pivotal step in unraveling the mystery of the missing diplomat's disappearance. Following a trail through Stormwind's underbelly, an investigator corners Dashel Stonefist in Old Town to force answers out of the stubborn ruffian.

sections.title: A Friendly Chat in Old Town
sections.body: Tracking the fate of the missing diplomat leads deep into the shadows of Old Town, where cutpurses and shady brokers mingle away from the watchful eyes of the Cathedral. Dashel Stonefist is known to harbor ties to the city's unsavory factions and holds valuable information regarding the abduction, but he isn't keen on sharing it willingly with agents asking sensitive questions.

sections.title: Brawl in the Alley
sections.body: When approached, Dashel quickly drops any pretense of cooperation. Backed by his loyal Old Town thugs, he attempts to beat down inquisitive travelers and silence the investigation permanently. Subduing Dashel and cutting down his backup proves to be the only language he respects, quickly changing his tune and opening the door to the next lead in the conspiracy.

faq.answer: Dashel Stonefist is a shady character lurking in Old Town with ties to Stormwind's criminal underworld. He acts as a local contact who knows far more than he lets on about illicit movements throughout the city.

faq.q: Why do I have to fight Dashel instead of just talking to him?
faq.answer: Dashel has no interest in cooperating with investigators. The moment you ask about the missing diplomat, he assumes you can be easily intimidated and calls in his thugs to silence you. Only a sound thrashing convinces him to talk.

faq.q: Do I have to kill Dashel Stonefist?
faq.answer: No. The goal is to beat him into submission rather than execute him. Once his health drops sufficiently low, he yields, calls off his cronies, and agrees to answer your questions.

faq.q: Where does this fight take place?
faq.answer: The confrontation takes place out in the open in Old Town, near the alleys behind the pig and whistle tavern and local training halls where Stonefist typically hangs around.
Once bested, a humbled Dashel apologizes and becomes willing to spill what he knows about the conspiracy, directing the investigation to the next link in the chain outside the capital.

faq.q: What is 'The Missing Diplomat' chain really about?
faq.answer: While officially presented as a search for a lost ambassador, the quest chain uncovers a web of deceit surrounding the diplomat's abduction and the shadowy figures orchestrating it.

angles.text: Old Town is your natural habitat, and dealing with brutes like Dashel Stonefist is routine business when shaking down contacts for street-level intelligence.
Discovering that local thugs in Stormwind's own capital are actively hindering the search for the missing king strikes at the very heart of the kingdom's security.
Every lead on the diplomat's disappearance is critical to uncovering the internal treachery threatening the stability of the Alliance leadership.
